description: Historical FDA Advisory Committee drug-related vote outcomes. Every record MUST have source-backed provenance (source_url, publication_date, source_doc_type). Records without provenance are rejected by the validator and excluded from empirical scoring.
provenance_policy: No record may power empirical_* basis scoring without a verifiable source_url pointing to an FDA meeting document, Federal Register notice, or published press coverage with an explicit publication_date.

records.indication: Transfusion-dependent anemia in lower-risk myelodysplastic syndromes (LR-MDS)
records.notes: ODAC voted 12-2 in favor of imetelstat clinical benefit/risk profile. FDA approved Jun 2024. Verified from 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (accession 0000950170-24-031475).

records.indication: Triple-class exposed relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma
records.notes: ODAC voted 8-3 favorable benefit/risk based on KarMMa-3 Phase 3 including OS. sBLA for earlier lines. Verified from 8-K (accession 0001860782-24-000032).

records.committee: Cardiovascular and Renal Drugs Advisory Committee
records.notes: CRDAC voted 9-3 benefits outweigh risks for patisiran sNDA for ATTR-CM. Verified from 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (accession 0001193125-23-253084).
GeMDAC voted 11-5 that data support efficacy. PDUFA Sep 21, 2024 but FDA issued CRL. Verified from 8-K (accession 0001437749-24-024543).

records.indication: COVID-19 (hospitalized adults at high risk of ARDS)
records.notes: PRDAC voted 8-5 that benefits do NOT outweigh risks for sabizabulin EUA. vote_yes=5 (favorable to drug), vote_no=8 (against). Verified from 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (accession 0001193125-22-297978).

records.committee: Endocrinologic and Metabolic Drugs Advisory Committee
records.notes: EMDAC voted 10-7 benefits outweigh risks for teplizumab to delay clinical T1D. FDA approved Nov 2022 as TZIELD. Verified from 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (accession 0001493152-21-013131).

records.committee: Molecular and Clinical Genetics Panel of the Medical Devices Advisory Committee
records.notes: Panel voted 8-1 safe, 6-3 effective, 7-2 benefits>risks. Primary question (benefits>risks) recorded. FDA approved May 2024. Verified from 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (accession 0001193125-24-146510).

records.committee: Cardiovascular and Renal Drugs Advisory Committee
records.indication: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF)
records.notes: CRDAC voted 8-3 that benefits do NOT outweigh risks. vote_yes=3 (favorable), vote_no=8 (against). Based on GALACTIC-HF Phase 3. Verified from 8-K (accession 0000950170-22-026478).

records.indication: Previously treated NSCLC harboring HER2 exon 20 insertion mutations
records.notes: ODAC voted 9-4 that benefits do NOT outweigh risks. vote_yes=4 (favorable), vote_no=9 (against). Verified from 8-K Exhibit 99.2 (accession 0001193125-22-250274).

records.committee: Peripheral and Central Nervous System Drugs Advisory Committee
records.notes: PCNSDAC voted 4-6 on efficacy question based on CENTAUR Phase 2. FDA later held re-review (Sep 2022, voted 7-2 favor) and approved as Relyvrio. Verified from 8-K (accession 0000950170-22-009674).
